featured_reviews.name: Prashant
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you love Chole Bhature, this place is a must-try!
Visited this place recently and had a good overall experience. The chole bhature here are definitely a highlight. I tried the chole cheese bhature and it was very satisfying. The Amritsari kulcha was also good and worth trying. Overall, it’s definitely worth the money.
That said, the place has a few practical limitations. There are no washroom facilities, parking can be quite difficult to find, and there’s no wheelchair-accessible parking. The surrounding area is usually crowded with slow-moving traffic and narrow roads, so reaching and parking can take some effort.
If you’re okay with these inconveniences, it’s a great spot for tasty North Indian street-style food.

featured_reviews.name: Alok Misra
featured_reviews.review_text: Literally a Hole in the wall but with amazing and authentic food. The chole bhature and Amritsari Kulchas (made in the tandoor) were to die for. Both come with unlimited refills of the delicious chole. This is in the lane leading up to Dashmesh Gurudwara. Parking is a problem so best to Uber it. Some street parking on the main road. We went on a Sunday so the faithful were thronging to the Gurudwara. We saw a cross section of patrons at this place - many seemed like regulars. Folks were also getting takeaway (as did we) and orders from platforms were also flying in. The owner is a nice friendly person and quite chatty as well. The setting is pretty much a classic dhaba type with very basic tables and chairs and a few fans (non there were no manjis!). We will be back for more but once the weather gets hotter it may just be for takeaway. Also this place serves only vegetarian food and also has jain options (priced extra)

I have been visiting this outlet for the past one year, and I have also been to multiple Subway outlets and other restaurants. However, this particular Subway outlet truly stands out as a great place to relax and enjoy food, mainly because of the staff.

I have been seeing the same team consistently, and it genuinely makes me happy to visit this restaurant. In fact, I come to this outlet especially because of the way the staff treats customers and provides hospitality—it is truly commendable and unbelievable.

I would like to specially appreciate Sahil and Abdullah. They are amazing, warm, and professional individuals. Because of them, I always feel like coming back again and again. Their friendly behavior, connection with customers, and excellent service make a big difference.

Thank you so much, Subway, for having such dedicated staff. I hope they continue to be part of this outlet, as they are the reason I choose this Subway location every time.

Warm regards,

I got the
1)Mutton Dabba Gosht: succulent meat, creamy taste. Literally the best dabba gosht ive eaten yet. They didnt skim out on the serving. Enough for 1 person to be full. ₹290

2) Bagdadi Roti: Huge Khamiri roti a little burnt ends as well. Adds chariness to the muttons flavour. For ₹25 amazimg value.

3) Bagdadi Fried Chicken: Huge leg piece with the extended up thigh of the chicken. Huge piece, perfectly fried, felt like i was eating tandoori fried chicken. Would absolutely recommend for the price of ₹150.

featured_reviews.name: Adil Syed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Location & Popularity
Bagdadi is located in a prime area of Colaba, making it easily accessible and always buzzing with people. The restaurant is extremely popular, especially during evening hours, which clearly reflects its strong reputation among food lovers.

Waiting Time
Due to the heavy rush during peak hours, particularly in the evenings, customers usually have to wait for their turn. While the wait can be a bit long, it also speaks volumes about how loved the food here is.

Food Quality
The food at Bagdadi is genuinely great. The flavors are rich, consistent, and worth coming back for. It’s one of those places where the taste truly lives up to the hype.

Ambience & Renovation (Personal Opinion)
In my personal opinion, the restaurant could really benefit from a renovation. The place feels a bit dated, and a refresh would greatly enhance the dining experience without taking away from its old-school charm.

Final Verdict
Bagdadi is a must-visit for its excellent food and prime Colaba location. Despite the waiting time and the need for renovation, the taste and authenticity make it well worth the experience—especially for those who don’t mind a little wait for good food.

featured_reviews.name: Dinesh Kumar Arumugam
featured_reviews.review_text:
Poor Service at McDonald’s Colaba – Disappointing Experience*

Visited McDonald’s Colaba on a busy day and had a very disappointing experience.

1. *Staff attitude*: The woman staff did not even bother to attend to us initially. When we asked for a softy, she was arrogant and simply told us to wait without any basic courtesy.
2. *Payment issue*: After placing the order, she mentioned “only cash” accepted. No prior info, no UPI/cards – which is strange for McDonald’s in 2026.
3. *No bill provided*: She did not provide the bill. So there’s no way to know if this was properly accounted for. This raises concern about transparency.
4. *Food quality*: The softy served was very melted and not even fully filled. Far below McDonald’s standard.

*Overall*: Such staff behavior brings down the name of McDonald’s. I was a one-time visitor, but I can only imagine the challenge regular customers face if this continues. Basic service, billing transparency, and product quality were all missing.

*Suggestion to McDonald’s*: Please look into staff training, enable digital payments, and ensure bills are given for every order. Customer service should match the brand.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Modern Juice Center is an absolute gem if you’re craving flavor-packed shawarmas and juicy, satisfying burgers! 🌯🍔
Their shawarma is perfectly spiced, loaded with tender meat, and wrapped just right — every bite hits with bold, Middle Eastern-inspired flavors. The burgers? Super juicy, cheesy, and loaded with all the good stuff.

Pair it with one of their fresh juices or thick shakes, and you’ve got yourself a complete, lip-smacking meal.

Great taste, quick service, and pocket-friendly prices — what more can you ask for? A must-try spot for street-style cravings done right! 🔥

featured_reviews.name: Mufaddal Patanwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked in the bustling lanes of Colaba, Modern Juice Centre has quietly become one of my most reliable late-night go-to spots. Whenever post-10 pm cravings kick in, this place is almost always on my mind—mainly because it stays open late and never disappoints.

My absolute top picks here are the mulberry juice and tender coconut drink. The mulberry juice has a rich, slightly tangy sweetness that feels both refreshing and indulgent at the same time, while the tender coconut is as clean and hydrating as it gets—perfect balance after a long day.

When it comes to food, their sandwiches and shorma are my default add-ons. The sandwiches are crisp, well-filled, and consistently satisfying, while the shorma is simple but hits the spot, especially late at night when you want something filling yet not too heavy.

What makes this place special is its reliability—you know exactly what you’ll get every single time. No fancy setup, no frills—just good food, quick service, and the comfort of knowing it’s there when most places have shut down. For late-night hunger in South Mumbai, this spot is hard to beat.

featured_reviews.name: Aziz _004
featured_reviews.review_text:
Modern Juice Center serves bold, flavorful shawarmas, juicy loaded burgers, and refreshing fresh juices/shakes all at great prices.

With quick service and consistently tasty street-style food, it’s a must-visit spot for satisfying cravings.

One of my favorites is the chicken shawarma tender, well-spiced, and delicious along with their cold coffee shake, which is rich, refreshing, and the perfect match.

featured_reviews.name: Hirak Deb
featured_reviews.review_text: Age old eatery on Colaba Causeway. Sharing table with large crowd and a reasonable wait period. Service is polite and prompt. Day's specialty gets over by midday. Menu is large and very economically priced, taste is very average and touristic.

featured_reviews.name: Murtaza Anverali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Kheema Pav Review: Heaven‑Level Street Fix

This is the version you tell people about: hot keema—fine‑grain mutton, tomatoes, green chili—heaped on a plate with butter‑licked pav maska toasted till the edges crunch. Special Chai arrives in a huge glass, milky‑sweet with ginger bite, just enough to cut the fat. You break pav, drag it through keema, sip chai, repeat. It’s messy, fast, and perfect at 8 am when the stall lights flick on. You really do have to eat it there to get the story. 10/10, no substitutes.

featured_reviews.name: Tomas Kramar
featured_reviews.review_text: Went here because it was recommended in the Dishoom book but felt very disappointed. Ordered bun maska with chai and we were served a stale crumbly brioche that the server picked up from a box, packaged in a plastic wrap. The bun looked like a burger bun and had little nibs of colorful jelly mixed in. The people around us were eating proper bun maskas with pav and it seemed to me that we have perhaps been served a bastardized version intentionally to cater to our foreign palates. I asked the waiter if we can get the same dish as the other guests were eating, but English was obviously a problem and we have just received the bill and the waiter cleaned the table. I hope this was just a misunderstanding, but if you are a western tourist, eat elsewhere.

An extremely efficient operation. Great friendly staff. Upstairs lounge with full AC.

All foods were safe and clean.

A must visit for anyone in Colaba.
